GWA_FleetRecon.name: Fleet Reconnaissance / Ghostwind Arrow
GWA_FleetRecon.description: Small Fleet reconnaissance crews that verify routes, investigate contacts and anomalies, support search and rescue, and return actionable evidence before larger forces or civilian traffic commit.
symbols: deep navy / blue / white Fleet identity
GWA_FleetRecon.politicalNotes: Their authority is practical and bounded: they can recommend, escort, warn, or certify within evidence, but a scout report should distinguish observation from interpretation.

GWA_Vergeroute.name: Verge Relief Convoy
GWA_Vergeroute.description: Civilian freighter crews carrying food, medicine, machinery and ordinary trade cargo across routes whose reliability directly affects settlement survival.
GWA_Vergeroute.politicalNotes: Waiting is not cost-free. Civilian pressure on the Fleet can be legitimate without making an unsafe route safe.

GWA_LatticeResearch.name: Lattice Survey Practice
GWA_LatticeResearch.description: The cross-faction technical practice of measuring reciprocal-field corridors, local shear, timing, anchors, echoes and post-Shattering anomalies.
GWA_LatticeResearch.politicalNotes: Measurements are objective; models remain provisional. Formal theory and local pilot experience can contribute evidence without making physics culturally relative.
